3201.title: Account Pooler erases transport diagnostics during fallback
3201.rootCauseOneLine: The hub replaces every fetch rejection with a cause-less error, then retries the same transport boundary with each eligible account.

prReviews.topFinding: Retains a sanitized cause and isolates upstream requests from the shared HTTP/2 dispatcher, but the native session-destruction trigger remains unverified.

3201.proposedFix: Retain and sanitize the transport cause, distinguish origin-wide failures from account-local failures, and verify transport replacement without ambiguous POST replay.
3201.caveats: The hub behavior reproduced twice; the native event that destroys a fresh HTTP/2 session remains unverified.
